Beginner.learningGoal: Write extension functions and properties to add behaviour to existing types.
gotchas: Extensions are resolved statically and cannot override members
A member with the same signature always wins over the extension

Intermediate.learningGoal: Choose between let, run, with, apply and also appropriately.
gotchas: apply and also return the receiver while let and run return the lambda result
it vs this: nested scopes shadow the receiver
goodSolutionShows: apply for object configuration, let for null handling, also for side effects
shapeHints: building a request object with apply
transforming a nullable value with let
logging in a chain with also

Advanced.learningGoal: Design small DSLs with lambdas with receivers and extension-based builders.
gotchas: Without @DslMarker inner lambdas can call outer receivers' functions
Lambda with receiver is T.() -> Unit vs (T) -> Unit
Builders need to collect state and return an immutable result
goodSolutionShows: Lambda-with-receiver builder creating an immutable result
Tests that assert the built structure
shapeHints: an HTML-like builder with nested elements
a test-fixture builder for a user with addresses
